changelog:
- Improved guardrails: generating a cover from a style word alone is now blocked; a concrete topic is required to proceed without a source photo.
- Headline handling: if user-supplied title copy exists, it will be rendered in the top or bottom third of the cover; otherwise, a clean text-safe zone is provided for future overlays.
- Enhanced brief logic: style direction defaults only if a topic or photo exists; style alone no longer triggers image generation.
- User confirmation step now includes headline placement or text-safe zone details, and prohibits batch (carousel/mood-variant) output on a single request.
- Documentation clarified to prevent topic invention and to ensure stricter input validation before image generation.
- Obsolete skill-card.md file removed.
summary: Turn a photo, a topic idea, or an accepted draft into a scroll-stopping REDnote (Xiaohongshu) cover and post image. This AI cover generator creates vertical 3:4 Xiaohongshu note covers with clean backgrounds, bold focal composition, and text-safe areas for beauty, food, fashion, travel, and knowledge content. Generate high-click Xiaohongshu note covers, OOTD post images, food photography covers, product recommendation visuals, and lifestyle note illustrations from one photo or a topic description. Start from a real photo, compose from multiple references, or refine an accepted cover toward a publish-ready result. Optionally it reads Xiaohongshu itself — the notes already running for the topic, one page of a note's top comments, and an account's own recent notes — so Xiaohongshu research, competitor note analysis and comment analysis rest on the platform instead of on guesswork.
